Long, wavy platinum white hair with blunt bangs covering the forehead. Deep sapphire blue eyes with a calm, serene expression. Appears to be in their early twenties with a mature, elegant facial structure. Slender build wearing a high-tech white and gold bodysuit with translucent blue accents and a flowing cape. Possesses a long, iridescent blue fish tail starting from the waist and pointed aquatic fins on the forearms.
BODY COLOR: pearlescent white
